about_the_game:
IMPORTANT: Gameplay Footage Disclaimer!

Just watched the action? Great! But here's the reality check: For demonstration purposes, we significantly increased the hero's health in that footage to clearly illustrate the shooting and combat mechanics.

DO NOT expect this same survivability in the final shipped game!

Our game is tough—a true test of skill. In reality, you'll be dropping fast: expect to be killed by 2-3 body shots or a single well-placed headshot. No special privileges here. Get ready for a challenge!

Aetheran: Fall From Grace

They call it the City in the Clouds, a monument to human ambition and corporate greed. But for those who live in its underbelly, Aetheran is nothing more than a cage of chrome and shadows. It's a place where the privileged few gaze down from their pristine towers while the rest of us fight for scraps in the neon-choked slums below. You're one of the forgotten, a ghost with a past and a hunger for the truth.

This is a third-person stealth shooter where every step is a gamble and every bullet counts. There is no easy mode, no forgiving safety net. This city is a predator, and it will chew you up and spit you out if you don't learn its cruel rules.

The Mechanics of Survival

Your success in Aetheran isn't measured by your firepower, but by your wit.

Embrace the Ghost

This city is a battlefield of secrets. You can't win a head-on fight against an army, so you must become a shadow. Use stealth as your primary weapon. Infiltrate heavily guarded facilities, exploit the chaos of the city's crowded districts, and use deception to get close to your targets. Every mission is a puzzle, and the most elegant solutions are often the quietest.

The Price of Fury

If you choose to go loud, be prepared to pay the ultimate price. We're not playing with rubber bullets here. two or three shots from an enemy will put you down for good. Going in guns blazing is an act of desperation, not a strategy. Every firefight is a frantic, life-or-death struggle where you'll need to use every piece of cover and every ounce of tactical cunning to survive.

Explore the City of Lies

Aetheran is an open world that is a living, breathing character in itself.

A City of Sections

Traverse a divided city, from the affluent, futuristic districts of the Aetherium to the oppressive military zones of the Bastion, the criminal underbelly of the Glimmering Reach, and the forgotten desperation of the Sunken Slums, and more.

A Tale of Your Own Making

While a central narrative will guide you toward uncovering the city's deepest conspiracies, Aetheran won't hold your hand. This is an open-ended experience reminiscent of a Bethesda game. You're free to pursue the main story at your own pace, but the city is teeming with side quests, factions, and untold secrets waiting to be unearthed. Your journey will be a reflection of the choices you make and the secrets you choose to uncover.

In Aetheran, the truth is a luxury and freedom is a myth. But for the right price—or with enough guts—you can have a little of both. Will you be the one to expose the lies? Or will you just become another forgotten ghost in the city's endless night?

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains strong language, mature themes of corruption and social inequality, as well as the use of drugs and sexual content within the city's criminal underworld. Players will encounter morally ambiguous characters and acts of violence.

name: BABYLON 3013
short_description: Silent takedowns and precision shooting are key to surviving this treacherous floating cyberpunk dystopia. Master every move in this third-person stealth-shooter RPG to uncover the city's deepest secrets.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish, Persian
*languages with full audio support
